outputs.explanation: This is a spatial transcriptomics tissue image with cluster color-coding overlaid on tissue spots (a photograph/micrograph-type spatial map), not a bar chart or summary statistic plot requiring individual data points.
H&E photographs with manual region annotations; not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
H&E photograph plus spatial gene-expression heatmap overlays; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; overlaying individual data points on line plots is not applicable/would make them unreadable, so they are exempt.

The bar graph displays log2 fold-change values (a single derived statistic per gene from differential expression analysis, with associated p-values), not a mean of replicate measurements with variability that would require overlaid individual data points.
